ideas.title: Investigating Police Brutality in Minneapolis
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti and the use of excessive force by law enforcement in Minneapolis.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti?
What measures are being taken to address police brutality in Minneapolis?
ideas.insight: The shooting of Alex Pretti highlights the need for greater accountability and transparency in law enforcement. An in-depth investigation is needed to determine the circumstances surrounding the shooting and to identify potential solutions to address police brutality.

ideas.title: Uncovering Election Fraud in the 2020 Presidential Election
ideas.description: An investigation into the allegations of election fraud in the 2020 presidential election and the FBI's investigation into the matter.
questions: What are the allegations of election fraud in the 2020 presidential election?
What is the status of the FBI's investigation into the matter?
ideas.insight: The allegations of election fraud in the 2020 presidential election have raised concerns about the integrity of the electoral process. An investigation is needed to determine the extent of any potential election interference and to identify potential solutions to address the issue.
